text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend eight candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board: Candidate #1-223 Candidate #1-298 Candidate #1-425 Candidate #1-476 Candidate #1-567 Candidate #1-600 Candidate #1-640 Candidate #1-686 Candidate #1-728 Candidate #2-40 Candidate #2-79 Candidate #2-89 Candidate #2-98 Candidate #2-120 Candidate #2-135 Candidate #2-173 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 20, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
